title: Resolution urging Albany to require 9/11 curriculum in schools
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation requiring an age-appropriate 9/11 curriculum in all New York schools. The curriculum would cover the events of September 11, 2001, first responders' actions, and the attacks' lasting effects, including impacts on civil liberties and rises in Islamophobia and xenophobia. It references state bill A.8347, sponsored by Assembly Member Catalina Cruz.
